data.revised_prompt: A kestrel bird is in mid-flight, illuminated in soft and warm natural sunlight. The image emphasizes the elegance of the bird, its wings spread wide and its eyes focused on the ground below. It is set against the serene backdrop of a sky, and the viewer can perceive a sense of movement in the image. The illustration should adopt the subtle brush strokes and color blending typical of a watercolor painting, encapsulating the bird's grace and the ambiance of the surroundings.
